newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul to give tax break to infrastructure builders.
newsitem.headline: Seoul to give tax break to infrastructure builders.

text.p: South Korea's Finance Ministry said on Thursday it would provide tax incentives to infrastructure contractors from the second half of this year.
The tax break was aimed at attracting private-sector funds into government projects, the ministry said.
The ministry said the corporate tax rate for contractors dedicated wholly to infrastructure projects would be lowered by three percentage points to 25 percent.
Contractors and financial institutions lending to them would be allowed to issue long-term bonds with tax incentives. The maturity of the bonds would be 12 years or longer.
The ministry also said financial incentives would be offered to contractors completing projects earlier than scheduled.
